name: io.github.proscar87/oura-mcp
description: The Oura v2 API as an MCP server. Paginates, fixes the date range, warns when data is missing.

environmentVariables.name: OURA_SANDBOX
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to use Oura's official synthetic data with no credentials. The recommended way to try the server before authenticating.

environmentVariables.name: OURA_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: client_id of your Oura application, for OAuth2. Register one at https://cloud.ouraring.com/oauth/applications with the redirect http://localhost:9876/callback/ (the trailing slash is required).

environmentVariables.name: OURA_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: client_secret of your Oura application. Only needed when running `oura-mcp --authorize` and when refreshing the token.

environmentVariables.name: OURA_CREDENTIALS
environmentVariables.description: Where the OAuth2 credentials file lives. Defaults to ~/.config/oura-mcp/credentials.json, mode 600.

environmentVariables.name: OURA_PAT
environmentVariables.description: Oura Personal Access Token. Only if you already had one: Oura stopped issuing them in December 2025.

environmentVariables.name: OURA_PAT_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to a file holding the personal token. Preferable to OURA_PAT: an MCP server is registered in a JSON that gets backed up and shared when asking for help; a separate file rotates without touching the config.
